insights.title: Demand charge spike in July
insights.summary: ULA demand charge peaked in Jul (≈0.86M RMB), significantly higher than surrounding months.

insights.title: Power cost at local high level
insights.summary: GYA power cost in Jul reached local peak (~5.27M RMB) before declining trend.

insights.title: Power cost eased after July
insights.summary: ULA power cost declined in Aug (~4.67M RMB), easing pressure from July peak.

insights.title: Water cost volatility observed
insights.summary: ULA water cost dropped sharply in Aug but remains volatile MoM.

insights.title: Demand charge rebounded in Sep
insights.summary: ULA demand charge rebounded to ~0.78M RMB in Sep after Aug drop.

insights.title: Water cost continued declining
insights.summary: GYA water cost continued to decrease, indicating improved efficiency.

insights.title: Power cost reached trough
insights.summary: ULA power cost reached lowest level (~4.34M RMB) in Oct.

insights.title: Water cost jump in Oct
insights.summary: ULA water cost jumped to ~2.02K RMB in Oct and stayed high.

insights.title: Power cost stabilized in Nov
insights.summary: Both sites showed stabilized power cost levels in Nov.

insights.title: Demand charge moderately increased
insights.summary: ULA demand charge increased moderately in Nov (~0.47M RMB).

insights.title: Water cos increased dramatically
insights.summary: GYA water cost increased dramatically as chiller regularly cleaning.

insights.title: Year-end power cost stable
insights.summary: Power cost closed the year at stable levels for both sites.

insights.title: Demand charge reduced vs peaks
insights.summary: ULA demand charge in Dec stayed well below mid-year peaks.

insights.title: Power unit price increase
insights.summary: Power unit price increase almost +26% compared previous unit price.(0.53 to 0.67,PSB plan to  return on Feb or future, the unit price will be still 0.53)

insights.title: Demand charge reduced vs peaks
insights.summary: ULA demand charge in Jan stayed well below previous year's peaks.
